id: 05_Compressed Gas Cylinders Major and Minor Leaks Equipment Safety
title: 气瓶泄漏：大漏小漏怎么办
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/05_Compressed Gas Cylinders Major and Minor Leaks Equipment Safety.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/05_Compressed Gas Cylinders Major and Minor Leaks Equipment Safety/src.py

points.K1: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用
points.K2: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回
points.K8: 可燃、助燃气体：移走可燃物
points.K15: 事故和未遂事件都要上报
points.K16: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
points.S1: 拿不准，就按大泄漏处理
points.S2: 可燃气体泄漏：杜绝火源
points.S3: 窒息与中毒：不盲目施救

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身旁一排固定好的气瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway next to a row of strapped gas cylinders and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲气瓶漏气了怎么办。
overlay: 气瓶泄漏：大漏小漏怎么办

shots.scene: 小泄漏、大泄漏两个图标并排，中间一个天平
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a cylinder with a thin wisp of gas and a cylinder with a thick cloud of gas, with a balance scale between them. No people.
shots.narration: 先分清大漏小漏，再按步骤处理。

shots.scene: 阿杰在气瓶旁皱鼻子，听到嘶嘶声
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands near a gas cylinder, frowning and listening to a faint hissing sound.
shots.narration: 阿杰听到气瓶那边有嘶嘶声。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手要去拧瓶阀，小研在门口叫住他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches toward the cylinder valve while the female graduate student calls out to him from the doorway.
shots.narration: 他想上前看看，小研叫住了他。

shots.scene: 小研指着气瓶上的空白标签问：什么气体？
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the blank label on the cylinder with a question mark icon above it.
shots.narration: 先弄清是什么气体，漏得有多大。

shots.section_title: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用
shots.scene: 锈迹斑斑、漆面剥落的气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas cylinder covered in rust spots with peeling paint and a dent. No people.
shots.narration: 预防漏气，从检查气瓶开始。
overlay: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用

shots.section_title: 破损锈蚀的气瓶及早停用
shots.scene: 锈蚀气瓶挂上空白停用牌，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A rusty cylinder with a blank out-of-service tag and a red X over it. No people.
shots.narration: 锈蚀、腐蚀、损坏的，漏之前就停用。

shots.section_title: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回
shots.scene: 老周把一只不再使用的气瓶放上推车，交给老李退回
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands an unused gas cylinder on a cart to the facility engineer to send back.
shots.narration: 不再使用的气瓶，及时退回。
overlay: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回

shots.section_title: 不用的、过检验期的气瓶退回
shots.scene: 瓶肩钢印特写旁出现日历图标，日期过期打叉
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of stamped marks on a cylinder shoulder next to a calendar icon with an expired date crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 超过检验有效期的，也要退回。

shots.scene: 一只气瓶接口冒出一缕细细的白气，旁边绿色小盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder fitting releasing a thin wisp of white gas, with a small green shield icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 小泄漏：量少、慢、能控制，

shots.scene: 惰性气体瓶图标，旁边低风险图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an inert gas cylinder next to a low-risk gauge with the needle in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 而且是惰性或低危害气体。

shots.scene: 一只气瓶喷出大团气雾，旁边红色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder releasing a large uncontrolled cloud of gas, with a red warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 大泄漏：量大、控制不住，危害严重。

shots.scene: 有毒气体瓶冒出一缕细气，旁边骷髅图标和红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A toxic gas cylinder with only a thin wisp of gas, next to a skull pictogram and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒、高危气体，漏一点也算大泄漏。

shots.scene: 小研向周围同学挥手提醒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waves and calls out to warn the students working nearby in the lab.
shots.narration: 小泄漏：先告诉周围的人。

shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on safety goggles and gloves over her lab coat.
shots.narration: 还没穿戴防护的，先穿戴好。

shots.scene: 小研用肥皂水检查接口和瓶阀，接口处没有气泡，瓶身连接处有气泡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student brushes soapy water on the regulator joint and valve; bubbles form at the cylinder valve itself.
shots.narration: 查一查：是接口漏，还是气瓶本身漏？

shots.scene: 扳手紧固后气泡仍在，旁边问号变为感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A wrench next to a valve that still shows bubbles, with an exclamation mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 紧固接头和阀门也止不住，才是瓶漏。

shots.scene: 通风橱和万向排风罩两个图标，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood and a flexible local exhaust arm, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 确保安全时，移到通风橱或排风罩下。

shots.scene: 一只气瓶被固定在通风良好的隔离角落，四周有空气流动箭头
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder secured in an isolated, well-ventilated corner with airflow arrows around it. No people.
shots.narration: 或者移到隔离、通风好的地方放空。

shots.section_title: 可燃、助燃气体：移走可燃物
shots.scene: 小研把纸箱、溶剂瓶从气瓶旁移开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves cardboard boxes and solvent bottles away from the leaking cylinder.
shots.narration: 可燃或助燃气体，移走旁边的可燃物。
overlay: 可燃、助燃气体：移走可燃物

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student walk out of the lab into the corridor.
shots.narration: 然后撤离附近区域。

shots.scene: 门上贴出警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A general warning sign posted on the closed lab door with a no entry icon below it. No people.
shots.narration: 门口贴出警示，别让人进去。

shots.scene: 小研打电话给老周
shots.prompt_en: In the corridor, the female graduate student phones the older man to report.
shots.narration: 通知实验室负责人和学院安全员。

shots.scene: 两人站在门外，旁边沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student wait outside the closed lab door, with an hourglass icon beside them.
shots.narration: 在区域外等着，直到气体放完。

shots.scene: 挂空白故障牌的气瓶放在推车上
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a blank fault tag secured on a cylinder cart, ready to be sent back. No people.
shots.narration: 漏气瓶退回供应单位修理。

shots.scene: 自己拆修瓶阀的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person taking apart a cylinder valve with tools, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别自己拆修瓶阀。

shots.scene: 实验室里气雾弥漫，警示灯闪烁
shots.prompt_en: A lab with a spreading cloud of gas from a cylinder and a flashing red warning lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 大泄漏，包括有毒气体漏一点，

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰快步撤离，顺手关门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student hurry out of the lab and close the door behind them.
shots.narration: 人员立即撤离，随手关门。

shots.scene: 手按下墙上的火灾报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses a fire alarm call point on a corridor wall. No people.
shots.narration: 按下楼内报警按钮，通知全楼。

shots.scene: 小研在安全处拨打电话，电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: In a safe place outside the building, the female graduate student makes a phone call; a fire icon and a red cross icon float beside her.
shots.narration: 拨打119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 小研向到场的保卫处值班员说明情况，手里拿着空白气瓶清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student explains the situation to the security officer at the building entrance, holding a blank cylinder list.
shots.narration: 救援人员到场，说清是什么气体、在哪。

shots.scene: 气瓶、位置、人员三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a gas cylinder, a location pin and a group of people. No people.
shots.narration: 漏了多久、有没有人还在里面。

shots.section_title: 事故和未遂事件都要上报
shots.scene: 王老师在空白记录本上登记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes in a blank incident logbook with the female graduate student beside him.
shots.narration: 事故、事件、未遂事件，都要上报。
overlay: 事故和未遂事件都要上报

shots.section_title: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的气瓶安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank gas cylinder safety handbook.
shots.narration: 细则查本校手册，不懂就问。
overlay: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.section_title: 拿不准，就按大泄漏处理
shots.scene: 欣欣双手摊开，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its paws with a question mark icon beside it.
shots.narration: 不知道是什么气体，或拿不准大小？
overlay: 拿不准，就按大泄漏处理

shots.section_title: 拿不准，就按大泄漏处理
shots.scene: 人员向出口撤离的图标，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of people moving toward an exit door with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 就按大泄漏处理，先撤离再报告。

shots.section_title: 拿不准，就按大泄漏处理
shots.scene: 未经培训的人靠近漏气瓶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an untrained person approaching a leaking cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没培训、没防护，不去碰漏气瓶。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：杜绝火源
shots.scene: 可燃气体瓶图标旁，火焰、电灯开关、手机三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A flammable gas cylinder icon next to a flame, a light switch and a mobile phone icon, all crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体泄漏，严禁明火。
overlay: 可燃气体泄漏：杜绝火源

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：杜绝火源
shots.scene: 开关电器的图标被红叉划掉，窗户打开有风
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand flipping an electrical switch crossed out with a red X, and an open window with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 不开关电器，能安全开窗就开窗。

shots.section_title: 可燃气体泄漏：杜绝火源
shots.scene: 小研在实验室外打电话
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call in the corridor far from the lab door.
shots.narration: 电话到安全的地方再打。

shots.section_title: 窒息与中毒：不盲目施救
shots.scene: 氮气等惰性气体瓶图标旁，人员缺氧示意图标
shots.prompt_en: An inert gas cylinder icon beside a pictogram of a person short of breath in a small closed room. No people.
shots.narration: 惰性气体漏多了，同样会让人窒息。
overlay: 窒息与中毒：不盲目施救

shots.section_title: 窒息与中毒：不盲目施救
shots.scene: 阿杰要冲进去拉倒地的人，被小研拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts to rush back into the lab toward a fallen figure, and the female graduate student holds him back.
shots.narration: 有人倒下，别贸然冲进去救。

shots.section_title: 窒息与中毒：不盲目施救
shots.scene: 戴空气呼吸器的救援人员图标走向实验室门，电话和红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: Pictogram icons of rescuers wearing breathing apparatus approach a lab door, with a telephone icon and a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 拨打120，等专业人员戴防护救援。

shots.section_title: 窒息与中毒：不盲目施救
shots.scene: 室外树下，一个休息的人形图标和新鲜空气图标
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person resting outdoors under a tree with a fresh-air wind icon. No people.
shots.narration: 救出的人转移到空气新鲜处。

shots.scene: 实验室墙上的气体报警器亮绿灯，上方有排风口
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector alarm unit glowing green on a lab wall below an exhaust vent. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒、可燃气体，装好气体报警器。

shots.scene: 小研用肥皂水定期检查接口，在空白巡检表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks fittings with soapy water and ticks a blank inspection checklist.
shots.narration: 定期检漏，巡检要记录。

shots.scene: 老周、小研和王老师围坐讨论空白事故报告
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the safety administrator discuss a blank incident report at a table.
shots.narration: 事后查原因，改措施，防止再犯。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现锈蚀气瓶打叉、日历图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a rusty cylinder crossed out and a calendar.
shots.narration: 破损、过期的气瓶，及早停用退回。

shots.scene: 小泄漏流程：通知、防护、通风、撤离四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a speaking person, goggles, a fume hood and an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 小漏：通知、防护、通风放空、撤离。

shots.scene: 大泄漏流程：撤离、报警按钮、电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: an exit door, a fire alarm call point and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 大漏：撤离、报警、拨电话报告。

shots.scene: 火焰打叉、警示三角、报告单三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a crossed-out flame, a warning triangle and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 拿不准按大漏办，事后都要上报。

shots.scene: 欣欣在走廊里挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in a bright corridor outside a lab door.
shots.narration: 遇到漏气不慌张，先保人，下次见！
